text:
flo (events): quick thought  mini picnic + mocktail swap next Fri after work? low-key, bring a small homemade or store-bought mocktail (or just bring yourself). options for spot: 1) Parklet (near HQ, grass), 2) Alley Patio (covered, heaters), 3) Office Commons (indoors). start 6:15 or 7:00? also thinking a tiny patchwork blanket swap: bring a small blanket or scarf to trade. RSVP + any allergies. :leafy_green: :sparkles:

rami: Parklet sounds adorable. 6:15 for me (can bring mint syrup and non-alc mojitos). veg snacks ok here. :herb:

claire: Alley Patio if there's heaters. 7:00 preferred. also allergic to sesame FYI.

owen: Im up for Office Commons (weather risky). 6:15 works, i can bring ice + a tub of ginger syrup.

tasha: Picnic+swap is cute. Prefer Parklet 7pm so I can hop over after class. I can sew a couple tiny patches if anyone wants custom labels. :scissors:

sam: leaning Alley Patio b/c covered. 6:15 or 7 both okay. happy to bring non-dairy snacks.

flo (events): sounds split. making a short ops-bot poll so we can lock a spot and ill post final deets tomorrow morning. if Parklet wins ill bring bug spray and a speaker; Alley Patio ill check heater availability; Office Commons ill reserve the corner by the beanbags. also planning a tiny "best mocktail" ribbon (joke prize). :ribbon:

ops-bot: Poll: "Fri picnic + mocktail swap - pick spot & time"  Parklet  2 votes  6:15  Alley Patio  2 votes  7:00  Office Commons  1 vote (ends in 14h)

rami: if Parklet wins i'll bring a small vegan hummus plate (no sesame) + mint mocktails.

claire: if Alley wins please confirm heaters, otherwise i'll bow out (cold!).

owen: if Office Commons wins, i'll bring a cheap battery fairylight string.

tasha: tiny patchwork swap rules proposal: each blanket must be no bigger than 2'x2', label with name + "swap if you like" tag. yay or nay?

sam: yea that rule sounds good. can label mine "sam - no nuts" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

flo (events): Love the swap rule. I'm jotting that down. Poll ends overnight; i'll lock by 10am tomorrow and DM those bringing food about allergies. Everyone else, react to ops-bot poll or drop your vote here. see you for a cozy end-of-week hang! :sparkles:
